title: 第1173章 抓阄抽取第1171章 竟然是他
slug: 开局黑狼拳简化后让我学狼叫
content_zh:
赵寒收回视线，转而在一群轻声交流的观众里来回看去。
“论道要开始了，我倒要看看是谁在暗中整幺蛾子！”
“那个九幽的神秘存在，定然会出现！”
赵寒这一眼看去，立刻有不少人感应到，特别是其中的大帝强者。
除了虬髯大汉伪装的儒生，绿袍老祖伪装的道士外。
还有至少十人察觉到赵寒赤裸裸的目光。
不过他们追踪赵寒视线时，却已经被掐断，没看出来是谁刚才肆无忌惮打量他们。
一行四波人在结束最后的领悟后，便纷纷飞了过来，来到四大擂台上空。
并恭敬的站成四个队伍，分别对应四位首座。
“参见首座，我等已准备就绪，随时可以开始论道！”
五十二人齐声说道，每个人都自信满满。
四名首座同时点头，然后相互看了对方一眼。
接着四人齐齐出手，制造出三副不同的五十二个无字金牌。
分别为三十二枚小型金牌，十六枚中型金牌，四枚大型金牌。
论道采取的，依旧是传统的抓阄。
考验的不止是实力，还有气运。
“开始抽取！”
三十二名神域境神色一震，纷纷看向了金牌。
可当他们第一时间看中一枚金牌时，还来不及选择，那枚金牌就消失于虚空，直接落到他们手里。
可谓一眼万年，第一眼看中哪个就是你的。

有些同时看中一枚金牌的，也是最先看中的得到这枚金牌。
三十二人几乎没有选择的余地。
很快，三十二人通通得到了属于自己的金牌，并且金牌上浮现出了对应数字。
从“壹贰叁”开始一直到“拾陆”。
对应数字的自然互为对手。
甚至其中不分儒释道魔，两个儒生互为对手的概率也很大。
所以说抓阄不止看实力，更要看运气。
此刻抽取结果出来，云灵儿匹配到的是一位魔门神域境真魔。
其中，释门的运气不是太好。
竟然有两对两两匹配上了，属于是自己人有预见性的提前就会淘汰两个。
其他三大圣地，则内部各有一对匹配上。
当十六对选出，接下来是明珠这类武帝进行选择。
虽然是随机的，但他们还是要谨慎不少。
最终八对武帝选手选出，只有儒门内部匹配上了一对。
是一名有着绝世容颜，二九芳华的女子，对上一名沉着冷静的中年儒生。
而明珠，则是对上一名道门的道君。
不过明珠并未吸引赵寒的目光。
反而那名十八岁的女儒生，引得赵寒非常意外。
并且不得不将视线紧紧看过去。
只见这名十八岁的女儒生，竟然和杨诗雨长的几乎八到九分相像。

连气质都有七分近似，几乎就是从一个模子刻出来的。
可以说是杨诗雨再年轻个十岁的版本。
只要是见过两人的，都必然会觉得两人非常相似。
虽然整个世界以相貌而言，长的一模一样的也有不少，甚至一名大帝和一名普通人，也有可能有非常近似的长相。
content_en:
Zhao Han withdrew his gaze and looked back and forth among the audience who were chatting softly.
"The discussion is about to begin, and I want to see who is behind this!"
"That mysterious existence from the Nine Netherworld will definitely appear!"
When Zhao Han looked at it, many people immediately sensed it, especially the powerful emperor among them.
Except for the tall man with beard who pretended to be a Confucian scholar and the ancestor in green robe who pretended to be a Taoist priest.
At least ten other people noticed Zhao Han's naked gaze.
However, when they followed Zhao Han's line of sight, they were cut off, and they didn't see who was looking at them unscrupulously just now.
After the four waves of people finished their final realization, they flew over one after another and came to the sky above the four major arenas.
And respectfully stood in four teams, corresponding to the four first seats.
"See the first seat, we are ready and can start discussing the Tao at any time!"
Fifty-two people said in unison, everyone was confident.
The four leaders nodded at the same time, and then looked at each other.
Then the four people took action together and created three different sets of fifty-two gold medals without words.
There are thirty-two small gold medals, sixteen medium gold medals, and four large gold medals.
The method of discussing Taoism is still the traditional drawing of lots.
What is tested is not only strength, but also luck.
"Start extracting!"
The thirty-two gods in the realm were shocked and looked at the gold medal.
But when they first spotted a gold medal, before they had time to choose, the gold medal disappeared into the void and fell directly into their hands.
It can be said that the first thing you see is yours.
Some people who are interested in a gold medal at the same time are also the first to get the gold medal.
Thirty-two people had almost no choice.
Soon, all thirty-two people got their own gold medals, and the corresponding numbers appeared on the gold medals.
Starting from "One Twenty Three" to "Shi Lu".
Those with corresponding numbers are naturally rivals.
Even among them, regardless of whether they are Confucian, Buddhist, Taoist or demonic, there is a high probability that two Confucian scholars will be rivals of each other.
So drawing lots depends not only on strength, but also on luck.
At this moment, the results of the extraction came out, and Yun Ling'er matched with a true demon in the realm of the Demon Sect God Realm.
Among them, Shimen's luck was not very good.
There were actually two pairs matched up, and one of our own had the foresight to eliminate two of them in advance.
The other three holy places each have a matching pair inside.
When the sixteen pairs were selected, the next step was for the Martial Emperor like Mingzhu to make the selection.
Although it is random, they still have to be a lot more cautious.
In the end, eight pairs of Martial Emperor contestants were selected, and only one pair was matched within the Confucian sect.
She is a woman with a peerless appearance and twenty-nine years of youth, facing a calm, middle-aged Confucian scholar.
Mingzhu, on the other hand, is facing a Taoist master from a Taoist sect.
However, the pearl did not attract Zhao Han's attention.
On the contrary, the eighteen-year-old female Confucian scholar made Zhao Han very surprised.
And had to look closely.
I saw that this eighteen-year-old female Confucian scholar was almost eight to nine points similar to Yang Shiyu.
Even the temperament is similar, almost carved from the same mold.
It can be said to be a ten-year-younger version of Yang Shiyu.
Anyone who has seen the two of them will definitely feel that they are very similar.
Although there are many people in the world who look exactly the same in appearance, even an emperor and an ordinary person may have very similar looks.
